act.name: Specific Relief Act, 1963
act.source_authority: Ministry of Law and Justice, Government of India
act.description: Central civil law governing possession, specific performance, declarations, cancellation and injunctions.

sections.title: Cases in which specific performance of contract enforceable.
sections.text: Section 10 governs enforcement of specific performance of contracts subject to the Act.
sections.plain_language_summary: A court may require performance of a contract in cases governed by the Act, subject to statutory limits.

sections.title: Substituted performance of contract
sections.text: Section 20 provides for substituted performance after the required notice and on the conditions stated by the Act.
sections.plain_language_summary: After proper notice, an aggrieved party may arrange performance through another person and seek eligible costs.

sections.title: Discretion of court as to declaration of status or right.
sections.text: Section 34 permits declaratory relief concerning legal character or a right to property in appropriate cases.
sections.plain_language_summary: A person may seek a court declaration of legal status or property rights when the statutory conditions are met.

sections.title: Perpetual injunction when granted.
sections.text: Section 38 states when a court may grant a perpetual injunction to prevent breach of an obligation.
sections.plain_language_summary: A final injunction may stop an ongoing or threatened violation of a legal obligation in eligible cases.

sections.title: Mandatory injunctions.
sections.text: Section 39 states when a court may grant a mandatory injunction requiring specified acts to prevent breach.
sections.plain_language_summary: A court may order a person to perform a necessary act to prevent or correct a breach in eligible cases.
synonyms: court se kaam karwane ka order
